# Merriam-Webster

> > America's most trusted dictionary and language resource, offering over 300,000 definitions, word games, etymology, and vocabulary tools for students, writers, and word enthusiasts.

Merriam-Webster provides comprehensive dictionary services including the Collegiate Dictionary (Twelfth Edition), specialized resources like slang dictionaries, daily vocabulary features, and word game solvers for Scrabble and other games. Available across web, iOS, Android, and through educational tools designed specifically for students.

## Key Topics

- Dictionary definitions and reference
- Word of the Day
- Scrabble and word game solving
- Etymology and word origins
- Slang and Gen Z language
- Merriam-Webster's Collegiate Dictionary
- Vocabulary building and learning
- Student and educational resources
- Mobile apps (iOS, Android)
- Word games (Quordle, Blossom, Quizzitive)
- Language usage and examples
- Latin and word roots

## Core Dictionary & Reference

- [Merriam-Webster: America's Most Trusted Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/): Homepage with 300,000+ definitions, word games, and language resources
- [Merriam-Webster's Collegiate Dictionary, Twelfth Edition](https://www.merriam-webster.com/collegiate-dictionary-twelfth-edition): Collegiate Dictionary Twelfth Edition product page for students & pros
- [Slang Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/slang): Gen Z slang, trending words, phrases, and emoji definitions

## Word Games & Solvers

- [Word Finder: Scrabble & Word Game Solver](https://www.merriam-webster.com/wordfinder): Scrabble word solver and comprehensive word search tool by letter combo

## Vocabulary & Learning Tools

- [Word of the Day Calendar](https://www.merriam-webster.com/word-of-the-day/calendar): Daily vocabulary feature with podcast, email, and social media delivery
- [Student Dictionary for Kids](https://www.merriam-webster.com/kids): Student Dictionary for kids with educational games and vocab building

## Mobile Apps & Platforms

- [Dictionary and Word Game Apps](https://www.merriam-webster.com/apps): Mobile dictionary and word game apps for iOS and Android platforms
